title: NEOWISE 2014-2024: unblended 12 um-excess dwarfs vary at 3-5 um 12 times more often than controls, but field-kinematics stars vary 3 times less often than known extreme debris discs predict
abstract: Prior campaign work linked deep dust dimming of field dwarfs to extreme warm dust, and found that most of 951 Gaia DR3 dwarfs with an AllWISE 12 um excess are blends. Known extreme debris discs (EDDs) around young stars nearly all change at 3-5 um. We asked whether the warm dust of unblended excess dwarfs also changes, and if mature stars behave like EDDs. We built NEOWISE-R visit light curves (2014-2024, about 20 visits) for 2,491 excess candidates and 2,821 W1-matched field-dwarf controls, and called a star W2-variable when its reduced chi2 exceeded that of 99 percent of controls at the same W1. Unblended excess stars vary in 25 of 213 cases (11.7 percent; controls 1.0 percent; p = 6e-16). No variable unblended star moves its WISE centroid with flux, but 46 of 89 variable blends do. Fourteen variables have young-like kinematics, nine of them in the Orion region; their rate (14/60 with an excess estimate) matches a transfer test that puts the W2 disc changes of 12 known EDDs onto each star (15.5 expected). Stars with field kinematics vary in 11 of 137 cases (8 of 130 after artefact cuts), but the EDD transfer predicts 33.5 +- 4.7 (p = 1e-7). A mixture fit gives a fraction 0.15 (95 percent: 0.04-0.31) of WISE-variable-disc behaviour, against 8 of 12 for known EDDs. Equivalently, if all genuine discs behaved like EDDs, only 0.30 (0.15-0.52) of these stars would be genuine. Four field-kinematics IR variables, including the dimmer G4466, are also Gaia-variable (4/11, against 3/126 for constant ones, p = 0.0007, and 10/125 for variable blends, p = 0.016). Thus the warm dust of mature excess dwarfs is mostly quiet on decade scales, unlike young EDDs, and only a small subset changes its dust and optical light together. Limitations: blends closer than 0.1-1.6 arcsec cannot be excluded per star; kinematics are not ages; the photosphere comes from a Ks-W2 locus; 12 EDD templates only.
